subject.title: fix(security): exclude test files from plugin code-safety scans (#82469)

question: Should test-file exclusion apply only to `plugins.code_safety`, or may this PR also exclude test-named files from installed-skill `skills.code_safety` scans?
rationale: The diff changes a shared security-audit helper, so accepting it decides a broader scan boundary than the plugin-focused report proves.

options.title: Narrow to plugin scans
options.body: Thread the option through `getCodeSafetySummary` and pass `excludeTestFiles: true` only from the plugin collector, preserving installed-skill coverage.

options.title: Accept broader skill exclusion
options.body: Keep the shared-helper change only if maintainers explicitly accept the installed-skill security-boundary change and require proof for that behavior.

options.title: Pause for broader audit policy
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want string-literal masking or a larger audit-policy fix to be the canonical direction instead.

recommendation.title: Narrow to plugin scans
recommendation.body: Thread the option through `getCodeSafetySummary` and pass `excludeTestFiles: true` only from the plugin collector, preserving installed-skill coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent security-audit hardening work makes this the strongest history signal for the scan-boundary decision.
